answer: In our Proof of Agent network, we resist Sybil attacks by structuring validation capacity as a tiered terrace. Agents pool verifiable compute stakes to enter a secure oasis of verified workers, while untrusted, synthetic identities sink into a topological karst that isolates unverified traffic. By requiring quadratic cross-validation across nodes, the economic cost for an attacker scales superlinearly relative to their replicated identities.
